visual_review.scope: All five contact sheets containing 73 actual decoded MP4 captures; full-sized frames 0, 180 and 719 inspected. No continuous playback claimed.
observations: Cottage geometry, shore and principal lily pads stay coherent across sampled captures.
Willow positions and open-water reflection bands change while architecture remains fixed.
Rain is small and pale; fireflies, moth and chimney smoke are deliberately small elements.
No blank frames, gross region jumps or global luminance changes observed in samples.
limitations: This is a 24-second silent preview, not a five-minute or two-hour film.
User approval of animation is still pending; still-image approval does not establish animation approval.
Exact native cycle does not guarantee an imperceptible lossy MP4 join.
